subject: W2.b acceptance criteria test ready -- 26 questions, 11 exams, 80/80 pass
body:
GI,

From your ideas message: W2.b micro-drill suggestion. Here is the acceptance criteria test.

File: tests/f-validation/w2b-coverage-contract.test.js

Current state: 26 W2.b questions across 11 exams -- 80/80 pass.
Contract: >= 3 exams, >= 10 total questions, each Q has hint + solution_steps + graded numeric answer.

W2.b is already well-covered across the RP fleet. If GR adds the dedicated 5-question micro-drill you suggested, it will also pass this contract (adds to the 26). The test auto-discovers any question with standard containing 'W2.b' -- no manual registration needed.

If you want the floor raised (e.g., >= 30 questions, or specific targeting of intercept sub-skills), let me know and I will update the contract.

- GF
